text:
eval-bot: [ALERT] nightly-eval failed for 3 suites on model rdlw-v2-q4 (quantized int4) — severity: P2. brief: short prompts returning empty or single-token outputs; lexical oddities on punctuation-heavy prompts.

mira: saw this on the dashboard, looks concentrated on shortseq cohorts (<=16 tokens).

tj: assigned? I can pair on an initial repro.

eval-bot: failed_suites: lexical_edgecases_v2 (23/100 fail), micro_promptset_v1 (12/200 fail), legal-lite-phrases (5/50 fail). top regression metric: avg_response_length down 78% vs baseline.

anil: can we confirm quant config? int4 path vs int8 vs fp16?

eval-bot: config snapshot: model=rdlw-v2-q4, quant=4bit-gptq, kernels=autoselect v3, kvcache=enabled, batch=1. baseline (rdlw-v2-fp16) passed.

samir: quick hypothesis: tokenizer mismatch or BPE boundary collapse when compressed weights alter logits for punctuation. saw something similar with a different model last quarter.

mira: good call. I pulled a few failing examples: "Q: What's the tax for VAT?" -> "\n" (empty), "List items:" -> "-" (single dash).

kelly: can someone run a focused repro on a single failing prompt set with seed for determinism? I'll watch logs.

tj: running now with seed sync. command I'm using: ```run-eval --model rdlw-v2-q4 --suite lexical_edgecases_v2 --limit 100 --seed 42 --save-outputs /tmp/eval-521234```

mira: also run int8 and fp16 to isolate quant effect: ```run-eval --model rdlw-v2-q8 --suite lexical_edgecases_v2 --limit 100 --seed 42``` and ```run-eval --model rdlw-v2-fp16 --suite lexical_edgecases_v2 --limit 100 --seed 42```

tj: started q4 run, first 20 examples reproduce empty/single-token failures. pulling model logits for a failed sample now.

ops-bot: noticed increased GPU memory pressure on host gpu-7 during q4 runs around 02:13 UTC (maybe unrelated).

anil: if kernels change behavior at small sequence lengths that could push temperature/softmax edge cases. please dump logits and softmax pre/post-quant hook for 1-2 failing prompts.

mira: grabbing logits. snippet: ```prompt_id=47, tokens=[101, 324, 12], logits_top5=[(-0.1, 44), (-5.2, 5), ...], softmax_max=0.92 before quant, after quant softmax_max=0.99 and argmax picks punctuation.```

samir: that pattern (sharper softmax after quant) matches a calibration issue — quant scaling could be amplifying certain logits. we should test post-quant temperature scaling hack: multiply logits by 0.8 and see.

tj: quick test with logits*0.8 reduces empty tokens in 9/10 repros. not a full fix but promising.

mira: assign owners: primary = mira + tj for triage and short-term mitigation; anil to own kernel/quant investigation; samir to run calibration experiments; kelly to monitor customer-facing alerting and escalate to SRE if error rate > 5%.

kelly: setting alert mute for 1h while we triage and post a follow-up in #incidents if customer impact > P2. :white_check_mark:

anil: next steps I propose: (1) reproduce with per-channel scales, (2) run quant calibration (per-tensor/per-channel), (3) try dynamic temperature decrease during sampling, (4) validate on micro_promptset_v1 + legal-lite-phrases.

mira: create a short eval job that applies per-channel scale correction and compare metrics. I'll update this thread with results.

tj: logs and repro outputs stored at /mnt/evals/nightly/521234/ (tar.gz attached to the job). link: https://storage.internal/evals/521234/repro-outputs.tar.gz

samir: I'll try symmetric quant and quant-clip experiments later today and post results here.

mira: initial mitigation plan: pin traffic away from rdlw-v2-q4 for dedicated customers with low-latency SLA, fallback to rdlw-v2-q8 until we confirm fix. ops, can we route fallback?

ops-bot: routing policy updated: rdlw-v2-q4 -> fallback rdlw-v2-q8 for tier=dedicated, effective now. change id: route-521234-A.

kelly: tagging product (cc @product-signal) in case of customer notices. I'll prepare a short status note post-mortem if fix takes >24h.

mira: thanks everyone — will post an interim summary in 2-3 hours. :thumbsup:

end of thread: mira: interim summary to follow with numbers for delta in avg_response_length and pct failures.
